nodes.title: Wave 6-A: booking and box-office screens consume the contract-only OpenAPI and the loopback gate (skeleton)
nodes.spec:
Objective: the booking (/booking/:eventId) and box-office (/) screens consume the contract-only OpenAPI catalogue and the loopback integration gate as a skeleton (kix-protocol PROGRAM_DECISIONS_20260928.md §6 line 125; Wave 6 gate §3 line 72). Today every desk method is status not-bound (packages/protocol-adapter/src/commerce-bindings.ts) and the screens call only desk methods.
Scope: contract consumption and mock backend only (Wave 6 scope). The PR body must cite the gate comment https://github.com/BeautifulMind-JT/kix-protocol/issues/56#issuecomment-5868307343.
Keep the existing fail-closed rules: stub is the default, loopback http://127.0.0.1 only, one attempt, no stub fallback, production and truth flags false (README.md).
Out of scope: real payment, public production deployment, real KYC (§3); credit disbursement (F04 stays mock); product SLOs; Wave 7 marketing changes; any change in kix-protocol.
Known limits: the catalogue has no list or read command; confirmBooking to capture needs amount, currency and paymentId; the browser path is blocked by CORS and needs a gate change in kix-protocol (docs/http-integration-gate-apps-bind.md). Do not add a proxy or map a desk method onto a different body; if the skeleton needs to cross one of these limits, stop with DECISION_REQUIRED.
Acceptance: a mock end-to-end journey on at least one surface (for example booking) aligned with the contracts, verified by tests (the Node tests against the live gate are acceptable); Commerce apps CI green at the exact head, including Typecheck, build, and test (stub).
